root_text:
Human Metapneumovirus (#hMPV) is a common respiratory virus that typically causes mild symptoms. No need to panic!
✔️ Focus on maintaining good hygiene.
✔️ Practice proper respiratory care.
✔️ Seek medical advice if symptoms worsen.
#StayHe
